findings.evidence: Mathlib has no such constructor: `grep -n 'def .*: GroupExtension' mathlib/Mathlib/GroupTheory/GroupExtension/*.lean` yields only `Defs.lean:326 def toGroupExtension` (semidirect product). TauCeti has no such constructor either: `grep -rn 'range_inl_eq_ker_rightHom' code/TauCeti` yields only `GroupExtension/OfFactorSet.lean:242` (factor-set-specific) and the new `DoubleCover.lean:56`. Second consumer: roadmap `RepresentationTheory/SpinRepresentations/README.md:347` — "Assemble the short exact sequences `1 → ℤ/2 → Pin(V) → O(V) → 1` and `1 → ℤ/2 → Spin(V) → SO(V) → 1`".
findings.fix: State the general result first, in `TauCeti/GroupTheory/GroupExtension/` (a prerequisite PR is fine per the one-topic rule): `def GroupExtension.ofMulEquivKer {N E G} [Group N] [Group E] [Group G] {f : E →* G} (hf : Function.Surjective f) (e : N ≃* f.ker) : GroupExtension N E G` with `inl := f.ker.subtype.comp e.toMonoidHom`, plus `@[simp]` lemmas `inl_apply : (ofMulEquivKer hf e).inl n = (e n : E)` and `rightHom : (ofMulEquivKer hf e).rightHom = f`. Then `spinDoubleCoverOfSurjective hV Q hQ hsurj := GroupExtension.ofMulEquivKer hsurj (zmodTwoMulEquivSpinKernel hV Q hQ)`, and `spinDoubleCoverOfSurjective_inl_ofAdd_one` / `_rightHom` reduce to the generic simp lemmas composed with `zmodTwoMulEquivSpinKernel_apply_ofAdd_one`.
findings.issue: `spinDoubleCoverOfSurjective` proves a purely group-theoretic fact — a surjective `f : E →* G` together with `e : N ≃* f.ker` is a `GroupExtension N E G` — inline in a Clifford file. Nothing in `inl`, `inl_injective`, or `range_inl_eq_ker_rightHom` (lines 51-60) mentions Clifford algebras, quadratic forms, or `ZMod 2`; the same three obligations recur verbatim for the Pin extension the roadmap asks for in this layer.

summary: Hypotheses are all used and at the right strength, and the surjectivity parameterization is correctly general. But the extension construction itself is generic group theory proved inline for Spin, when the general statement is short, absent from Mathlib and from TauCeti's own GroupExtension directory, and has a second roadmap consumer (the Pin/O extension).
